title: Arc Relay — Home Siege v3 strict 9–2 proof
intro: Outcome-visible review of both mirrored v3 assignments from the fresh 24/24 canonical WASM cohort, followed by the retained v2 visual reference. V3 faces the unchanged stock-v4 coordination-parity opponent. The historical v2 card is explicitly labelled because its retained replay faces the older static baseline. Eligibility bars were frozen; no detector was weakened to admit the siege.

cards.title: Home Siege v3 — Blue
cards.subtitle: Blue v3 vs coordination-parity stock-v4 · Blue wins 9–1 at t560 with 3 integrity
cards.opponent: Orange is the unchanged stock-v4 coordination-parity control: ordinary coordinated focus fire and movement, but no Home Siege recognition or bespoke counter-plan.
cards.score: Blue 9–1 Orange Core deliveries; Blue destroys the reactor at t560 and retains all 3 integrity segments. All twelve fresh Blue-assignment cells reproduce this score and tick.
cards.trigger: The standing strategy assaults immediately, occupies after a stable foothold, regroups when the living blockade collapses, and rebreaches after five bodies restabilize at the forward rally. Carrier sight arms one bounded interceptor; a conversion window leases one courier and one escort.
cards.tactic: Maintain a five-body living blockade while one interceptor cuts the predicted return lane and the courier/escort pair converts safe Cores. Replacements independently catch up and only then rejoin formation.
cards.counterplay: Break the five-body seal, isolate the Patchbays, force repeated regroup cycles, screen the return lane, or exploit the temporarily concentrated north approach. This opponent is a parity control, not the intended Stage-2 recognizer.
cards.fallback: A lost foothold releases occupation into regroup/rebreach. Carrier completion retargets or releases its exact lease immediately; an unwinnable cutoff becomes direct pressure; replacement lives remain outside formation cohesion until reintegrated.
cards.watch: Occupy t33; regroup t112; breach t123; later cycles at t198/t274, t307/t318, and occupy again t346. At t77 the trace shows the exact 5+1+1+1 allocation; carrier retargets occur at t147 and later. All 22 observable replacement lives rejoin strategy.
